datasets.name: CustomersDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.id boorowerid, c.NAME boorowername
           FROM customers c
          WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT p.boorowerid
                           FROM cm_portfolio p
                          WHERE p.boorowerid = c.id)

datasets.name: PReservesDataset
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent, description
  FROM cm_reserves
ORDER BY percent

datasets.name: SReservesDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, percent, description
  FROM cm_reserves
ORDER BY percent

datasets.name: MainDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.currency, p.boorowerid, p.expertid,
       p.usrgroup, p.branchid, p.usid,
       p.customertype, p.credittype, p.personaltype,h.rest*o.ostat rest,
       h.interestrest*o.ostat interestrest, h.duerest, h.dueinterestrest, h.reserveid, h.duereserveid,
       h.obligation, g.pledgeid,
       av.val_name, c.name
  FROM cm_portfolio p,
       cm_curr_state h,
       AVALUTE av,
       CM_GUARANTEE g,
       customers c,OPERKURS o
where (p.id = h.creditid) and
      (p.currency = av.valute) and
      (p.id = g.creditid(+)) and
      (c.id = p.boorowerid) and p.currency=o.val_kod  and o.dat=:dat

datasets.name: DateDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.currency, p.boorowerid,  p.expertid,
       p.usrgroup, p.branchid, p.usid,
       p.customertype, p.credittype, p.personaltype,h.rest*o.ostat rest,
       h.interestrest*o.ostat interestrest, h.duerest, h.dueinterestrest, h.reserveid, h.duereserveid,
       h.obligation, g.pledgeid,
       av.val_name, c.name
  FROM cm_portfolio p,
       cm_history h,
       AVALUTE av,
       CM_GUARANTEE g,
       customers c,OPERKURS o
where (p.id = h.creditid) and
      (p.currency = av.valute) and
      (p.id = g.creditid(+)) and
      (c.id = p.boorowerid) and p.currency=o.val_kod  and o.dat=:Hdate and h.hdate=:Hdate
